evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates creating a game with name/description.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from joining (PP-029) and from invite-limit (PP-028); no other story expresses the same invite-by-URL requirement.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated elsewhere; other item stories concern list management/selection rather than starting a round via entry field.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar theme to PP-031 (estimators see all items) but different actor/role; not a duplicate per QUS guidance.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from re-estimating earlier items (PP-013) and from CRUD on items (PP-006/7/8).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action; not duplicated by PP-003 (start round) or PP-007/PP-008 (edit/delete).

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action; no other story repeats editing items.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Different from PP-033 which shows estimates only after all have estimated; not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from entering an agreed estimate (PP-012) and auto-fill when unanimous (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Specific automation rule; not duplicated by PP-010 (average) or PP-012 (manual entry).

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry differs meaningfully from accepting average (PP-010) and auto-fill (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation capability is distinct from selecting an item (PP-005) and from viewing prior rounds (PP-039).

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with PP-015 (copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet); both express bringing stories from a spreadsheet into the system with no clear meaningful difference in goal/business rule beyond method wording.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-014 at the requirement level (getting stories from a spreadsheet into the game); one is substantially contained in the other without a clear distinct rule/context.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Different from viewing/exporting a specific game transcript (PP-017/18/19).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from exporting transcripts (PP-018/PP-019) and from browsing games (PP-016).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Different export format and requirement than CSV export (PP-019) and viewing transcript (PP-017).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Different export format and requirement than HTML export (PP-018).

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting an account (PP-024) and deleting an item (PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Unique account-creation requirement; not duplicated by login/change/delete/password reminder stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Unique authentication action; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from account creation (PP-021), deletion (PP-024), and password reminder (PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting a game (PP-020) and other account operations.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story covers timezone localization.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Unique password recovery requirement; not duplicated by other account stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Unique configuration requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Adds a specific constraint (limit) not present in PP-002; not a duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from moderator inviting via URL (PP-002).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Unique to showing current item; not duplicated by viewing all items (PP-031/PP-004).

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar to PP-004 but different actor/role; allowed as separate per criterion guidance.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Different from seeing the actual estimates (PP-033/PP-036); this is about status/acknowledgement of submission.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-009 (show early) and from PP-036 (who gave what during current round) in intent/timing.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Substantially the same requirement as PP-041 (change estimate until draw completed); no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-039 (scroll back through stories/estimates from prior rounds) because this is per-estimator history for the current story.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Different from PP-032 (who has estimated) and PP-033 (simultaneous reveal rule).

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-038 which is about automatic reset behavior.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Adds separate automation behavior beyond starting the timer (PP-037).

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; overlaps thematically with PP-035 but covers general prior-round navigation rather than per-estimator prior estimates for the same story.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: No other story specifies card ordering consistency.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034 (change estimate until reveal/draw completion) with no meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Unique personalization requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from accessibility (PP-047) and browser compatibility (PP-046).

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story covers glossary/definitions.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Unique technical requirement; not duplicated by general performance story (PP-048).

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Unique cross-browser compatibility requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from XHTML/CSS compliance (PP-043) and browser compatibility (PP-046).

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: General performance requirement; not a duplicate of PP-045 (specific indexing approach).

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story covers Unicode/language support.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Unique requirement about URL structure; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates error-page requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Unique data anonymization/storage requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Unique analytics/metrics requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.
